mapper.select: SELECT d.production_order_no AS productionOrderNo, d.assembly_material_no AS assemblyMaterialNo, d.main_material_desc AS assemblyMaterialDesc, NVL(d.scheduled_quantity, 0) AS assemblyDemandQuantity, d.effective_scheduled_date AS scheduledDate, d.material_no AS componentMaterialNo, NVL(d.material_description, d.material_desc) AS componentMaterialDesc, d.demand_quantity AS demandQuantity, d.invested_quantity AS investedQuantity, d.procurement_type AS procurementType FROM demand_agg d

SELECT boo.production_order_no AS productionOrderNo, boo.material_no AS materialNo, boo.material_desc AS materialDesc, boo.order_date AS orderDate, boo.buyer_order_no AS buyerOrderNo, boo.line_item AS lineItem, GREATEST(NVL(boo.open_qty, NVL(boo.order_qty, 0) - NVL(boo.received_qty, 0)), 0) AS openQuantity, boo.required_arrival_date AS requiredArrivalDate, boo.supplier_desc AS supplierDesc FROM buyer_open_order boo WHERE boo.deleted = 0 AND GREATEST(NVL(boo.open_qty, NVL(boo.order_qty, 0) - NVL(boo.received_qty, 0)), 0) > 0 AND (boo.production_order_no, boo.material_no) IN
(#{key.productionOrderNo}, #{key.componentMaterialNo})
ORDER BY boo.production_order_no, boo.material_no, boo.required_arrival_date, boo.buyer_order_no, boo.line_item
